notes: Generator test (Noise By-law 6555 s. 4.1(c)): one set at a time is about 75.7 dB(A) at 9.1 m (the nearest lot line), within the 80 dB(A) test limit (78 dB(A) at 7 m, Kohler G6-154, maker claim; free field, our arithmetic). Sets tested together would be louder. Running in a power cut as emergency works (s. 4.3(c)): our reading (?).

Noise: needs a 4.9 m solid screen around the roof plant, no gaps, ≥ 20 kg/m²: −8 dB, NSW 2021 method (arch_nz_nswDcNoise), never more than FHWA's line-of-sight rule gives (arch_nz_fhwaNBDH). Taller than the units, so EVAPCO's wall rule needs more space or the maker's approval (?). Without it: about 71–74 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) at the point of reception beside 275 1ST AVE E (I-3, activity zone), 28 m away; limit 65 dBA at night (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii)).

Noise: with the standard (louder) unit rating the plant would exceed the 65 dBA night limit at the point of reception beside 275 1ST AVE E (I-3, activity zone) (about 63–66 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) with a 4.9 m solid screen (roof; NSW 2021, −8 dB), Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii)). With the quieter rating it is under, so this is not blocked: standard units would need low-noise chillers (Trane RTAF 280 LN, maker claim) + a 4.9 m solid screen (roof; NSW 2021, −8 dB).

loadingNeed.basis: 2 truck loading bays: 2 for the data centre's 1,457 m² of floor. Each class of use is counted separately and the counts added (Parking By-law s. 5.1, Multi-Use Developments). The by-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The data centre uses row 5.2.5: the by-law does not name data centres, but the City classes them as a Transportation and Storage use (RTS 19744), which row 5.2.5 lists. Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1).

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim). Chosen 29 Oct 2026 as the unit nearest the middle of …

genLines: 3 generator sets of about 1 MW carry 2.9 MW; with spares, 4. Placed: 0 on the roof, 4 in the yard.
Each about 8.434 × 2.616 m, 3.706 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 3100 L. In the yard: 3 m from the property line and 1.5 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.

<span class="src">Standby diesel generator sets in Sound Level 2 enclosures with sub-base tanks. Basis units: Rehlko (Kohler) KD2000, 2,000 kW standby (data-centre continuous rating the same), 13.49 × 3.49 m, up to 4.78 m high (G5-626, rev 6/24); KD1000, 1,000 kW, 8.43 × 2.62 m, 3.71 m high with the 12 h tank (G6-154, 12/23). Both EPA Tier 2, cULus (UL 2200, CSA C22.2 No. 100); manufacturer claims. Chosen 29 Oct 2026 as the middle of Cat, Rehlko and Generac: 2 MW 18.5–38.4 m² per MW, 1 MW 19.5–22.4. 1 m clear around each set (Cummins application manual; not checked ?); 1.5 m from wall openings…
